content.user_title: Design Apple Navigation Components with HIG Guidance
content.value_statement: Choosing the wrong navigation control creates confusing search and browsing experiences. This skill applies Apple HIG guidance to search fields, page controls, and path controls.
actual_capabilities: Recommends a search field, page control, or path control for a described navigation task.
Specifies expected behavior for search typing, page movement, scrubbing, and path navigation.
Explains platform differences across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, visionOS, and watchOS.
Reviews search placement, scopes, suggestions, tokens, and empty-state behavior.
Evaluates page-control indicator count, styling, positioning, and interaction choices.
Describes standard and pop-up path controls for macOS file hierarchies.
limitations: The skill provides design guidance but does not implement or test interface code.
Its references are snapshots and may not include later Apple guideline changes.
Path controls apply only to macOS according to the included guidance.
Recommendations still require validation with product requirements, accessibility testing, and target devices.

use_cases.title: Plan Mobile Search
use_cases.description: Choose search placement, focus behavior, scopes, and suggestions for an iOS or iPadOS content experience.

use_cases.title: Review Paginated Onboarding
use_cases.description: Check whether page controls fit a flat onboarding sequence and define indicator behavior.

use_cases.title: Design File Navigation
use_cases.description: Select a standard or pop-up path control for a macOS file workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a search field, page control, or path control for [workflow] on [platform]. Explain why it fits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner selection between supported navigation components

prompt_templates.title: Specify Search Behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Design search for [content type] on [platform]. Cover placement, focus, suggestions, scopes, results, empty states, and clearing behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Review Page Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this [page sequence] for Apple HIG alignment. Assess page count, indicator design, placement, tapping, scrubbing, animation, and platform constraints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured design review for paginated experiences

prompt_templates.title: Create a Cross-Platform Specification
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a navigation component specification for [product]. Compare iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, visionOS, and watchOS where relevant. Identify unsupported controls and alternatives.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced platform comparison and behavior specification

output_examples.input: Choose navigation for a five-screen iPhone onboarding flow.
output_examples.output: Use a centered page control near the bottom. Keep the sequence flat, show five indicators, and support direct page movement through swiping.

output_examples.input: Design search for a large macOS document library.
output: Place the search field at the trailing side of the toolbar.
Start with a broad scope, then offer scopes or tokens for document attributes.
Show relevant results quickly and keep clearing behavior consistent.

output_examples.input: Show the selected folder hierarchy in a Mac application.
output_examples.output: Use a standard path control in the window body. Display meaningful ancestors and let people select a segment to navigate.

best_practices: Provide the target platform, content type, dataset size, and importance of search.
Describe whether navigation is flat, hierarchical, or focused on discovery.
Validate recommendations against current Apple documentation and real device behavior.
anti_patterns: Do not use page controls for hierarchical or nonsequential navigation.
Do not request implementation code when only a design recommendation is needed.
Do not apply macOS path-control guidance to unsupported Apple platforms.

faq.question: Which components does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers search fields, page controls, and macOS path controls.

faq.question: Can it recommend search placement?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares tab bar, toolbar, inline, sidebar, and platform-specific placements.

faq.question: Does it generate SwiftUI or UIKit code?
faq.answer: No. It produces component recommendations and behavior specifications, not implementation code.

faq.question: Can I use page controls on macOS?
faq.answer: The included Apple guidance states that page controls are not supported in macOS.

faq.question: When should I use a path control?
faq.answer: Use one in a macOS window body to show and navigate a selected file or folder hierarchy.

faq.question: Does it replace accessibility testing?
faq.answer: No. Validate the proposed interface with accessibility checks, target devices, and product-specific testing.
